dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Doudou, be a good girl, let's go pick your medicine. You'll only get better if you take your medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: I'm not going, I'm not going! I hate the medicine at Bubu Pharmacy. I hate it!

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: You need to do as you're told, Doudou... And hey, if we go to Bubu Pharmacy, you'll get to see Baizhu. How about that?

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Wow, really? ...Mr. Baizhu is so nice, I'm sure just seeing him will make me better. Then I won't need any medicine!

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Hmm, but if poor Mr. Baizhu found out you didn't like his medicine...You wouldn't want to make him mad, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Erm... erm... What about if we just pick the medicine, but I don't take it?

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Doudou, be a good girl, let's go pick your medicine. You'll only get better if you take your medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: But I already ate it the last time, and I'm all better now! I don't wanna go!

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: If you stop taking your medicine after getting a little better, you'll get sick again... And if we go to Bubu Pharmacy, you'll get to see Baizhu. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Mr. Baizhu's so nice, I'm sure just seeing him will make me better. The medicine's bitter, so I'm not eating it!

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Hmm, but if poor Mr. Baizhu found out you didn't like his medicine...You wouldn't want to make him mad, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Erm... erm... What about if we just pick the medicine, but I don't take it?

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: Have you wished upon a lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: My wish this year is the same as last time — good health for my daughter, Hongdou.

dialogues.speaker: Chenxiang
dialogues.text: She is such a sickly child...
